title: Figure 18: Comparison of Known and Unknown Object Sightings by Color, 1947–1952
description: Back-to-back horizontal bar chart comparing "Total Less Unknown" sightings (left, in percent) with "Unknown" sightings (right, in percent) for each reported object color: White, Metallic, Not stated, Orange, Red and Other. Both axes run from 0 to 30 percent. Caption: "FIGURE 18 COMPARISON OF KNOWN AND UNKNOWN OBJECT SIGHTINGS BY COLOR, 1947-1952"; drawing A-7496.
